
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qiuzhendezhen/p/19254029" title="发布于 2025-11-21 17:59">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">FreeSWITCH的limit功能问题汇总</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img alt="头图-81" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202511/2500940-20251121175931012-1006310297.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h1 id="ycJt7"><span class="ne-text">概述</span></h1>
<p id="u05ace0f9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">FreeSWITCH的limit功能很好用，但是fs1.6版本中通过hiredis模块实现的limit有不少bug存在。</span></p>
<h1 id="bPOIQ"><span class="ne-text">环境</span></h1>
<p id="uab7b6c25" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">CentOS 7.9</span></p>
<p id="u711eec0c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">FreeSWITCH 1.6.20</span></p>
<h1 id="RJCaU"><span class="ne-text">问题</span></h1>
<p id="u2cdd3699" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">limit通过mod_hiredis模块实现并发限制的bug。</span></p>
<p id="uee402166" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">1，max=-1时，limit逻辑是按照0来实现的</span></p>
<p id="ud77be837" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">2，hiredis，redis的并发数据为负值时，并发到0时，limit返回失败，呼叫失败</span></p>
<p id="u2a6cb2b7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">3，hiredis，redis连接中断，limit返回失败，呼叫失败</span></p>
<p id="uf972612c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">4，hiredis主备切换时，并发数据有概率为负值</span></p>
<p id="u8be3671e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">5，线路方对一通呼叫同时返回bye+486消息，挂机回调事件会对limit并发数据decr俩次，引出负值</span></p>
<h1 id="dMyjT"><span class="ne-text">修复代码</span></h1>
<p id="u85a334cd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改mod_hiredis.c文件的“SWITCH_LIMIT_INCR(hiredis_limit_incr)”函数接口如下。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-c" data-language="c"><code>//modify by zr 20250613, for redis reps and max value
    count = atoll(response ? response : "");

    if (count &gt; 0)
    {
        limit_pvt = switch_core_alloc(session_pool, sizeof(hiredis_limit_pvt_t));
        limit_pvt-&gt;next = switch_channel_get_private(channel, "hiredis_limit_pvt");
        limit_pvt-&gt;realm = switch_core_strdup(session_pool, realm);
        limit_pvt-&gt;resource = switch_core_strdup(session_pool, resource);
        limit_pvt-&gt;limit_key = switch_core_strdup(session_pool, limit_key);
        limit_pvt-&gt;inc = 1;
        limit_pvt-&gt;interval = interval;
        switch_channel_set_private(channel, "hiredis_limit_pvt", limit_pvt);
    }

    if (!interval &amp;&amp; max &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; count &gt; max ) {
        switch_log_printf(SWITCH_CHANNEL_SESSION_LOG(session), SWITCH_LOG_INFO, "%s is already at max value (%d)\n", limit_key , max);
        switch_safe_free(hashkey);
        switch_safe_free(response);
        hashkey = switch_mprintf("decr %s", limit_key);
        if ( (status = hiredis_profile_execute_sync(profile, hashkey, &amp;response, session)) != SWITCH_STATUS_SUCCESS ) {
            if ( status == SWITCH_STATUS_SOCKERR &amp;&amp; profile-&gt;ignore_connect_fail ) {
                switch_log_printf(SWITCH_CHANNEL_SESSION_LOG(session), SWITCH_LOG_WARNING, "hiredis: profile[%s] connection error executing [%s] with limit already reached\n", realm, hashkey);
                switch_goto_status(SWITCH_STATUS_SUCCESS, done); // increment has been succesful but decrement have failed
            }
        }
    }

    // if ( !count || count &gt; max ) {
    if ( max &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; count &gt; max ) {
        switch_goto_status(SWITCH_STATUS_GENERR, done);
    }</code></pre>
<h1 id="io3ph"><span class="ne-text">总结</span></h1>
<p id="u52e8d1ac" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改后的hiredis重新编译安装后，问题解决。</span></p>
<p id="u60943f3e" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="ue7c5e998" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">空空如常</span></p>
<p id="u3577a95d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">求真得真</span></p>
